pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with soft edge gradients; spatial area is largest on the upper flank and becomes more condensed with smaller, more angular geometries toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-toned pathways forming a topological web with predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pixel thickness is consistent across the central flank but exhibits narrowing at the junction of the hindlimb.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude serrated mane profile visible along the upper neck and shoulder against the background; edge clarity is reduced by image resolution.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear disruption is visible on the mid-flank, appearing as a dark textural break in the continuity of the pelage pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism is perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction between the neck and the shoulder.
